## Prelimenaries

```{r}
# Loading Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```

## Loading Data

Loading Survey Data

```{r}
b_dice <- read_csv("data/dice_baseline_clean.csv")
```

Older codes that were used for basic cleaning for Randomization

```{r}
# change variable names to remove spaces
b_dice <- clean_names(b_dice) 

# make all villages lower case, remove spaces and underscores
b_dice <- b_dice %>%
  mutate(village_name = tolower(trimws(village_name)))

b_dice$health_facility_name <- gsub("_", " ", b_dice$health_facility_name)

# check distinct number of villages and facilities
n_distinct(b_dice$village_name) 

n_distinct(b_dice$health_facility_name) 

# drop individuals who are not caring for children AND are not expecting
b_dice <- b_dice %>%
  filter(if_any
         (c(are_you_currently_expecting_a_child_soon, 
            are_you_currently_caring_for_any_children_under_the_age_of_5_years), 
           ~ . != 0))

```
